notes.title: Experimental release competitive gaming
notes.notes:
Hello there community,

A few months ago I started with overhauling Evolvation. First step for me was to revise the keys in the circulation. This led to the accidental ban of activated keys. As you all know, this was never the intention. To fix the mistake I made the game free to be permanently added to the library. Crazy enough this had lead to two million downloads within a couple of days and overloaded our servers. 

This unexpected explosion of the game was never intended. We were not ready at all and the game was far from finished!  Unfortunately this had led to some negative reviews which I hoped to avoid since we knew that there were some improvements needed (which were planned to be overhauled, however we were not able to do that because of the unexpected commotion).

However, the upside of this story is that we were able to gain a great community which is currently setup via Discord (https://discord.gg/qWkaTGQ). With the community we organized events and discussed a new gamemodel. Based on the input of this great community we started our planned overhaul of Evolvation. 

So after a couple of months of hard work I am happy to announce the experimental release of the new gamemodel! Of course, it is not done yet. We are releasing this experimental branch to test if out with you guys and gain new input to optimize the game.

So, what does this new gamemodel mean? If you are interested in the proposal accepted by the community you are able to find it here: https://docs.hyperreuts.com/public-files/Evolvation_GamemodelProposal_3.0_HyperReuts_v1.6.pdf 

The most important changes of the experimental release includes at the moment:
•	New UI (With full credits of the design to @CaptainLel)
•	Finetuned the game for competitive gaming
  o	Completely overhauled all ship statistics
  o	Overhauled complete upgrading system. There is no upgrading system, 
        only predefined weapons and unlockable weapons, skins, perks etc.
  o	All weapon statistics are overhauled
  o	Weapon weight added: different bonuses and penalties of the weapon 
        based on weight and class of ship. E.g. heavy weapons have more 
        effect on the maneuverability and speed on light and less powerful ships 
        than ships with a heavy engine.
  o	Class system overhauled: We now have 5 classes with natural 
        opponents. Each class has a much stronger unique presence and 
        abilities than before. This also includes a complete overhaul of each 
        class statistic.
  o	Class abilities overhauled: e.g. Backwards teleport (Highspeed), homing 
        EMP (Support), Heatseaker (Tank) etc.
  o	Class abilities are now energy based. Not based on cooldown.
•	New weapons: Shotgun and flakgun are added.
•	A new map, Planetary Combat, is added for experimental testing, it is finetuned for very intense combat
•	And a lot more! But I will not try to bore you with all the details for now.

There are still a lot of things to be done before we can actually release this branch for instance:
•	We have problems with our login server. It sometimes take a bit longer than expected, we still need to tune it.
•	A very important gamemode for Evolvation still has to be created: A Domination like mode with control points.
•	Capture the HyperDrive gamemode is added but I do not think it works out at the moment. I was thinking about some changes like a king of the hill mode?
•	The UI does not work well with keyboard and controller at the moment.
•	Perks and cosmetics still need to be created, this is key for the game
•	An active and correct leaderboard needs to be updated and a new updated achievement system has to be implemented.
•	Sometimes bots stand still and are not being able to be destroyed.
•	Tutorial is not correct anymore, given the new game model.

I think these are the most important things for now. I cannot wait to test the game out with you guys and try to optimize is to your wishes!
Lets plan an event to meet and test the new model out!

To activate the experimental branch go to steam -> library -> Evolvation -> properties -> betas -> select the experimental beta branch and that’s it!

Please note that it is still for testing purposes only, until we are ready to bring the game completely to market! I want to avoid the negative reviews of people who do not understand that the game is in development.

Last but not least Jacob and I would like to use this message to thank all of you guys with the extensive help and feedback that you guys gave us. 
Without you, it would not be possible and it gives us the motivation to make the best! There are so many people that have helped us with for instance the UI, discussions about the new datamodel, translations (not completed yet), event organization , server management and hosting and a lot more! It is on our list to make an official credits list of all the people who have helped us. 

Let's make this game great again! Evolvation first!:Explosion_Blast:ːsteammockingː

With the kindest regards,

Eric and Jacob

Bonjour les pilotes,

We have two huge features this release which were requested a lot by our community: Joystick support and support for several languages. Read below for a more in detail update.

Main features:
 * Joystick support (experimental)
- Still experimental, since we feel this still has to be tuned. Please test it and let us know your ideas on how to improve this further.
- Default bindings for Thrustmaster T-Flight Hotas included

 * Localisation support
- Added support for French language (see options menu)
- Polish, Russian and Dutch translations are in progress
Improvements:
 * Improvement to sounds (engine and rocket trail make less noise, while flares are louder)
 * Improved 3rd person camera, it now moves more smooth.
 * On the scoreboard spaceship names are now displayed instead of "fighter 1" etc.
 * Menu now scales better (was required for localization support). There is still a lot to be done here (we are redesigning the UI)
- Bot strength increased
- And a lot of small other things
 
Bugfixes:
 * Fixed an issue for certain maps where other players were initially not visible and became visible after first respawn.
 * Fixed a bug with the support ship: lasers would sometimes bounce seemingly randomly when shooting.
 * Chat now properly scrolls down in case multiline text is added.
 * Fixed hosting of Free For All Matches
 * Negative count when flying outside of the level boundaries is now fixed
 * Bots no longer die at the end of a match
* And a lot of small other things
 

I would like to give a huge shoutout to all the people from the community that helped us for this release: For instance with the French translations (Colonel Mustard) and Extensive bugreports from a lot of people via the Discord Community (they keep us very busy :))
 

The community is currently working hard on further improvements of translations (Russian by  mrlol and Polish by  Blu') and a complete redesign of the UI (by CaptainLel). Next to those we are discussing a redesign of our current game model with a large group of people. If you like to help or join the discussions about Evolvation, join our discord: https://discord.gg/qWkaTGQ

notes.title: Thank you
notes.notes:
Hi there supporters,

My name is Eric Ruts. Together with a good friend I have created a game called Evolvation. During this exciting, but also exhausting two year development period, we finally launched the game out of early access. This is when we started to realize that the gaming market is undergoing an "indiepocalypse". There was sadly no way that the game would get anything near the attention and the amount of required players for a successful multiplayer game.

This was a major down set for us since our only goal was to let people enjoy themselves by playing a fun multiplayer to play with friends. Since my motivation is purely to create a game which is fun to play with friends I decided to not monetize the game by introducing game-destroying features like pay-to-win concepts. This however did not work since I am not able to reach a large audience.

The large part of our reviews are really positive and rewarding! Nearly all the negative reviews are about not having enough players online (and about how difficult the game is for noobs, haha). What a shame.

I really wanted the game to succeed so I asked my friend Jacob if he wanted to help me out with rebranding the game. So we worked hard to optimize the servers, reducing the game from 16gb to a quarter of that, testing new controls etc. We wanted to show this on the gamecon Firstlook to test out the Evolvation 2.0.

I once tried to boost the game by giving away 10.000 copies on SteamGifts. We chose to do this since we prioritize players having fun with our game instead of monetizing on it. We are just hobbyists. However, instead of playing most people used the keys for other purposes. I admit that I wanted to start our rebrand of the game with a clean slate so I made the stupid mistake to revoke the unredeemed keys and accidentally got the redeemed keys revoked to. I was spammed with hateful comments, negative reviews and accused of things like being “money hungry apes” and “scammer developers”. In minutes reddits and steamgifts forums exploded with these kind of things and I did not now what to do since it was never my intention to hurt anybody. I choked up and saw our work being destroyed in a matter of minutes… However, as soon I started to explain things and showed I wanted to do everything I possibly could I also got support of a lot of people which appreciated my honesty above all. Thank you very much for your support in this.

However, after multiple tries Steam did not provide me with new keys to resupply or help to release the pressure. So what to do? I already had chosen that I find it more important that people enjoy the game than to monetize it. So to solve the problem I made the decision to make the game completely free with the knowledge that I would not be able to monetize. So I contacted Steam to make this happen for me and they came through.

With all the negativity I encountered and have to deal with I really choked up and it made me feel very sad. However, I never expected that because of my honesty I also got a lot of positive feedback of you guys! That really made my day and am very grateful for that. And want to give you guys my deepest and heartfelt: “Thank you”. You guys make me believe again and encourage me to continue making games.

Feel free to try the game! But remember, the game is ridiculously difficult!

Spread the word and enjoy!

With the kindest regards,

Eric Ruts
Just a hobbyist

PS. I got a lot of requests to make a Patreon or another method to support us. I do not want to come over as a "money hungry ape" but to be honest all support is welcome. So I’ve created a PayPal button, it is the fastest thing I could come up with. So if you like the game, please consider supporting us. I am still paying server cost etc. With the money we would be able to improve the game, or even give us the possibility to continue in the gaming business. Thank you in advance!

notes.title: An indie developer misclicked, got review bombed and now their game's servers are "exploding"
notes.notes:
Remember the saying "there's no such thing as bad publicity"? Following the events of the last few days, at least one indie developer may disagree.

Evolvation, a space flying shooter made by two people, was originally released in February 2017. Earlier this week, it had an average concurrent player count of one person. Fast forward to today, and there are currently 53,487 people in-game, with a new all-time peak of 172,870 set yesterday evening. Unsurprisingly, the sudden influx of new players is breaking the small indie game's servers. How on earth did this happen?

Unbelievably, it apparently all began with one misclick.

notes.title: Official release of Evolvation!
notes.notes:
Hi there pilots!ːSpaceship_Rideː

The official release of Evolvation is finally there! With a team of just two people we wanted to bring you a great multiplayer experience in the form of a space shooter where you can fly your own ship. We got to talk to a lot of people from the community here on steam, visitors of the FirstLook festival and many others during the past months. So far it has been a great privilege to be able to do this and we hope you enjoyed it in the meantime!

The last couple of months have been quite intensive for the two of us, since we wanted the final release to be great! We worked hard on some of the latest features of the game and fixed all reported bugs. This release will add some additional features to the game that have been highly requested by our community. 

We have added 133 Achievements to the game for you to unlock! Enough playtime to enjoy yourselves! Besides these we now keep a lot of stats on every player in Evolvation, which has resulted in a lot of leaderboard data! We currently have 83 Leaderboard stats available for you to compare yourself against other players in Evolvation. All stats are available on a weekly and all-time basis. These are stats such as: kills, deaths, assists, kills with a laser, deaths by a blackhole, xp gained and many more!

If you had Evolvation on your wishlist for some time and are thinking about buying it now should be the time! Have a look on the video's made by other players to get a glimpse of what the game has to offer. Play against bots, your friends and other gamers out there!

Ofcourse, since this game is developed by only a two man team, bugs can still be present. If you encounter any problems, please do not hesitate cntacting us in any way you please. You can add us as friends and chat with us, post on the community hub or any other channel you prefer! We really want to deliver the best experience of Evolvation and are open for improvements and discussion.

This is the official release of Evolvation, but that does not mean we will stop developing. We already have some new content in development such as new maps!

We hope you have a blast!ːExplosion_Blastː

Enjoy and as always, fly safe!

Kind regards,

Jacob Kooijman and Eric Ruts

notes.title: Improved stability and Linux support!
notes.notes:
Hi Pilots,

The last few weeks we have been busy adding support for Linux and improving the overall stability of the game.

We always wanted to support Linux, since we think that Linux users are still a very relevant user group and should be able to play this game. We did test our Linux build quite extensively, but there could be issues regarding Linux that wouldn't occur on a Windows environment, please report them on our bug report forum if you encounter any!

During playtesting we noticed some big issues for users with mediocre internet connections, hence we tried to improve the network performance of the game. For technical enthousiasts it might be interesting how we actually did that, otherwise simply skip the next alinea.

We first started using a network lag simulation tool which can easily simulate high latency situations or situations where a lot of packets are dropped. This enabled us to simulate clients that have mediocre internet connections without much trouble and easily see how far we could push it. In the end we managed to bring down our network use by about 50% by using a networking profiler to trace which communications used the most bandwidth. Afterwards we went further, since we noticed that in case of high packet loss situations some data was not send correctly between host and clients. In the current state we can easily deal with 5% packet loss in combination with a ping of about 200, although it is of course noticable during gameplay. The game starts to react slower and the position of your enemies is not completely up to date in those situations.

We also noticed that our controller support was not completely stable. We improved this and we now really have 100% controller support. If you still find issues regarding this, please let us know on our forums!

Kind regards and happy flying!

Jacob Kooijman
On behalf of the HyperReuts team

notes.title: Evolvation 1.0.3 is here: Class abilities, Tutorials
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25939822/e8d100b8737e82e2c704f8aad9a8b0179ab5429c.jpg[/img]
Hi there Pilots!

Another major update for Evolvation! Version 1.0.3 is here and includes lots of improvements! For instance, the community gave us feedback about that the controls could be hard to learn and asked for a tutorial. We are happy to announce that the requested tutorial is present within this version! The tutorial includes the basics of flying up to how to configure your own spaceship.

Furthermore, all the class abilities are now present! Each spaceship has a primary and a secondary class ability. The class abilities are:

Tank
Primary:  A Powershield which decreases incoming damage.
Secondary: Dropping a mine which explodes when an enemy is near with a large explosion radius.

Support
Primary: Dropping a support package which contains primary and secondary ammo, health, energy, data, and flares. In the game mode Free for all the package will be directly assigned to itself.
Secondary: A “Support sphere”. If a teammate (and of course yourself) is within this sphere, they will be healed for a certain amount. However, if it is an enemy, they will receive some damage.

Stealth
Primary: Invisibility
Secondary: Dropping an electrical web. If an enemy flies through it, the energy will shut down for a couple of seconds which causes the spaceship to be uncontrollable.

Fighter
Primary: Damage bonus
Secondary: Normally, when locking an enemy, you will have to wait until the target is completely locked. With this ability you are able to fire three rockets to your enemy even though you only have started to lock your target.

Highspeed
Primary: A short power boost which enables the ship to make some special maneuvers
Secondary: A warp boost which will bring your spaceship to the end of the level in a matter of seconds.

Also, within this update, start-up times and issues are improved. However, if this causes problems for existing users they should delete the appdata of Evolvation which is stored at a windows computer at: %appdata%/../Local/EvolvationFinal

This folder should be completely deleted to prevent some start-up issues. 

Of course a lot more is improved, added and fixed! Check out the game and let us know what you think!

Happy flying!ːSpaceship_Rideː

Eric Ruts
On behalf of the HyperReuts team

Hereby we would like to inform you with our current developments! We are working hard towards Evolvation 1.0.3.

notes.title: Release notes Evolvation 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi there pilots!

Check out this huge update!

New features/improvements 
[list]
[*]AI released with many options including: 
[list]
[*]Possibility to setup the difficulty of the AI (easy, medium, hard or auto) 
[*]Different AI classes with random configurations for each AI 
[*]The AI uses all possible in game actions such as flares, locking, boost and class abilities 
[*]Each AI has a different and unique name 
[*]The XP bonus and data bonus from AI’s depends on the difficulty of the AI 
[/list]
[*]Overhaul of the scoreboard at the end of the game to display the top players and give information about the next map 
[*]Pickups now are attracted to the player when nearby to make it easier to take pickups 
[*]The default key bind to chat has been changed from the C key to T key to prevent accidently entering the chat while playing 
[*]Several presets for key binds are now provided to make it easier to change key binds for several standard configurations, including a mouse preset 
[*]Several FX (special effects) improvements such as: The engine trail, distortion waves, explosions and level boundaries and much more! 
[*]When leaving the level boundaries an green indicator named ‘map’ appears to guide the player back to the map 
[*]Removed several unused features from the game to prevent confusion 
[*]Map designs improvements such as: better spawn locations for team based gameplay and object placement 
[*]New game mode: Capture the Hyperdrive! (The game mode works similar to the familiar game mode Capture the flag, but now in space!) 
[/list]

Bug fixes 
[list]
[*]You are now not able to join a game without configuration; the exception here is joining via invite, which requires going back to the menu. 
[*]The number of remaining flares on a ship is now correctly shown and calculated 
[*]The loading screen now always displays the correct map name 
[*]Killing streaks now correctly resets when switching maps 
[*]The countdown when flying out of the level bounds now shows the correct values 
[*]If all sounds are disabled the engine sound is now correctly disabled as well 
[*]Lighting distortion on some objects is fixed
[*]Homing missiles are now correctly rotated in the direction they are flying 
[/list]

Known issues
[list]  
[*]AI in capture the HyperDrive is not working correctly 
It is hard to understand the first steps of the game without a tutorial  
Crosshair is not the specific aim point for forward thrust in third person 
[*]Mouse controls do not work as required  
[*]At respawn, the game freezes sometimes on particular systems  
[*]Start-up can take a couple of minutes with black screen.  This typically occurs only the first few times. 
[*]In the hangar, some weapons go through the ground.  
[*]Kill achievements do not work properly  
[*]Focus issues in menu, such as the pop-up at first startup  
[*]If a second screen is connected, resolution bugs can occur. This can result in no control of your spaceship. Workaround: Change resolution in game and apply settings.   
[*]Switching teams in lobby is unclear and can result into bugs such as the same player present in both teams  
[*]If chatting in the lobby, focus issues might appear.  
[*]All servers in the server list have a ping of 9999  
[*]The engine of the stealth ships are still in stealth mode after the stealth is finished.  
[*]Class abilities stats are not present  
[*]If an achievement is reached and the game is over, the achievement is shown behind the end-game screen.  
[*]Collision problems, hitbox of spaceship seems incorrect in some cases. 
[*]Sometimes after being eliminated, the locking indicator is still active  
[*]Class ability of the Highspeed does not increase the max speed 
[*]If the scoreboard is toggled to show while loading the next map it is impossible to hide the scoreboard (until the next game) 
[/list] 
 
What’s next? 
[list]  
[*]Clan support such as clan names  
[list]  
[*]You should be able to distinguish yourself as a member of a clan. Join games together, and enter tournaments. Add new members to your clan in a convenient clan hangar, and hang out together. It is more fun to play with friends![/list]   
[*]Joystick support  (Hotas) [list] 
[*]Everyone should be able to use the controller of their choice. A joystick will provide alternative controls, perfect for another gaming experience of Evolvation. [/list]    
[*]Maps [list]  
More maps allow everyone to show out their skills and will challenge the player to adopt to the diverse environments.[/list]     
[*]Spaceships  [list] 
[*]We aim to develop more ships to let everyone pick one of their choice. It is undefined to which class the ships will belong. [/list]    
[*]Gamemodes  [list] 
[*]More gamemodes need to be created particularly to enhance multiplayer gameplay. The gamemodes should let all the maps and space ship abilities come together to make a challenging game.  [/list]   
[*]Matchmaking [list]  
[*]More control in the host screen will let you set up a match which has restrictions for the players that can join.  [/list]   
[*]Quickmatch  [list] 
[*]Features such as automatic pooling should be implemented in the quickmatch, to let players land in games which are both challenging and enjoyable.  [/list]   
[*]Fairness indicator  [list] 
[*]Games in the serverlist should have an indication how experienced the players are to enable you to decide which game you want to join.  [/list]   
[*]Steam achievements  [list] 
[*]Steam achievement incorporation will allow you and other players to keep track of your achievements. [/list]    
[*]Dedicated servers    
[*]Kick player from game  [list] 
[*]Inactive players or those who are ruining the gameplay of Evolvation can be voted for to get kicked out of the match. Use and abuse of this function will be tracked to ensure the best gameplay possible.  [/list]   
[*]Voting system next map  [list] 
[*]Players should have the freedom to skip a map.  [/list]   
[*]Linux build  [list] 
[*]Extended support of more platforms will allow more people to play Evolvation.  [/list]   
[*]Mouse control improvements  [list] 
[*]Currently Evolvation supports but is not optimized for mouse control. [*]Improvements will make the mouse feel like a familiar and conventional addition to the game controls.  [/list]   
[*]Steam controller support  [list] 
[*]The steam controller is not yet supported but we aim to provide this option.[/list]     
[*]Customizable spaceships e.g. colour selection, decal placement. [list]  
[*]Features such as customizable colours of your ship will make it distinguishable and to your liking.  [/list]   
[*]Extra weapons  [list] 
[*]A range of weapons will allow you to pick a weapon that suits your playing style.  [/list]   
[*]Stability improvements  
[*]Achievements overview improvement  [list] 
[*]The overview should be clear and structured [/list]    
[*]Class abilities improvement  [list] 
[*]It may be difficult to understand and use the class abilities to their maximum.  [/list]   
[*]Stat balance improvement such as damage, health, bonuses from upgrades etc.  
[*]Tutorial  [list] 
A clear tutorial is needed to introduce players to the game. Guiding players through the process of buying and configuring their first spaceship to let them started to get the most out of Evolvation.  [/list]   
[*]Resolution improvements, some items are not aligned properly in the UI.  
Improve the structure of the complete GUI 
[*]Small single player mode  
[*]Private team message  [list] 
Implement a private chat to discuss everything you don’t want to share with your enemy.   [/list]   
[*]Ability to select default configuration  [list] 
[*]In the lobby or when joining in game the default configuration should be selected to provide a faster start of the game.  [/list]

notes.title: Evolvation 1.0.1 release notes
notes.notes:
1.0.1. is released! This is our first version which is publicly available. Evolvation 1.0.1 is available on steam as an early access release. Early access does not mean a pre-order or an early access to the full game. Early access is a playable version of the game which is NOT finished. There are still known and unknown bugs, game modes missing, etc. At each update of the game, we will provide you with a list of release notes. In these release notes we want to state the new features, bug fixes, the known bugs in the current version and what is next in our development process.

Feel free to join the discussion, report bugs and suggest improvements.

[h1]Current state[/h1]
Since this is our first public release we are not going to state the “new features” but explain the current state of the game. We will do this by stating the key features of the game in the current state.

[h1]Key features[/h1]
•	Upgrading system 
•	Levelling system
•	In-game currency system 
•	Locking system 
•	Flares 
•	Movement system 
•	Spaceships classes 
•	Pick-ups 
•	Multiplayer 
•	Game Modes 
•	Low and high end system support 
•	Camera options 
•	Input support 
•	Level bounds 
•	Environmental damage 
•	Chat system 

[h1]Upgrading system[/h1]
The player has the option to buy new spaceships, weapons, engines, computers and much more! You are able to configure your very own spaceship to your liking. Thousands of configurations are possible, so you can make your spaceship unique. But be aware, in order to buy an upgrade, you are required to have sufficient in-game currency. This currency can be acquired with several in game methods. 

[h1]Levelling system[/h1]
Each player gains experience points while playing Evolvation. With these experience points, you can level up. If a player levels up, they can unlock spaceships, weapons, computers and/or other perks. A player can gain experience points with: 

•	Kill points: For each enemy kill you receive XP 
•	Assist points: : If you inflicted a certain amount of damage and someone else finishes. You will receive assist points. 
•	Game points: For game related activities such as: capturing a flag, defending a control point, destroying an enemy base etc. 
•	Completing achievements: Evolvation contains a lot of achievements which rewards the player for achieving them. 
•	Winning a game: For winning a game, a player gains experience 
•	Finishing a game: Players get a small reward for finishing a game

[h1]In-game currency system:[/h1]
In the late future, the currency that we now take as granted, is no more. The evolving need of data in the future has become so important that is has become a currency. Gain data in Evolvation and buy and upgrade your spaceship with your collected data!

After taking the enemy out, a pick-up is dropped at the location of the enemy player which contains a certain amount of data. You are able to pick up this data. The data is in bytes. The data is divided into three categories: Terabytes, petabytes and exabytes. If you have collected 1000 terabytes, you will have 1 petabyte. If you have collected 1000 petabytes, you have one exabyte.

[h1]Locking system[/h1]
The player is able to equip their spaceship with a primary and a secondary weapon. Most of the secondary weapons are equipped with a locking device. This locking system uses a homing missile projectile. The targeting process is as follows: 


1.	The distance between your spaceship and the target should be no more than a certain maximum 
2.	The locking indicator has to be in a certain radius of the target 
3.	The indicator moves to the target 
4.	When the locking indicator reaches the target, the target is locked 
5.	The warning indicator of the target shows: ”locked” 
6.	You are now able to fire a projectile as a “homing missile” 
7.	The homing missile will follow the target. 
8.	The target will receive a warning indicator: “Missile inbound” 
9.	Unless the target evades the missile properly, the homing missile will be a direct hit!

[h1]Flares[/h1]
In order to evade a homing missile, some special manoeuvres can be executed. But the player has another option: Flares, sometimes known as “chaff”. Flares are an option to redirect an incoming homing projectile to another target. The new target will be the flare. If a homing projectile is in range of a flare, the missile prioritizes the flare above the original target. 

[h1]Movement system[/h1]
All of the spaceships are equipped with our amazing flying control set. This control set gives the player the possibility to move in any direction. It is possible to make looping’s, roll over, rotating while still moving in the original direction etc. During our playtests we already saw some very interesting moves and we are really curious how the community will use our movement system to its fullest!

It sounds like a lot of options, and might seem very complex to learn. But all of our test cases resulted in one conclusion: The controls are very intuitive and easy to learn. For basic movement, it is not necessary to use all the degrees of movement, but it is nice to know that you can always fly more advanced! 

[h1]Spaceship classes[/h1]

•	Energy Pick-ups

•	Primary ammo Pick-up 
This pick-up fills up the ammunition of your primary weapon. 
•	Secondary Ammo Pick-up 
This pick-up fills up the ammunition of your secondary weapon.

•	Team Deathmatch

•	Front-Cam
•	The camera is in the same position as it is in the cockpit mode but the cockpit is made invisible for a better overview.
•	Third Person cam
•	The camera follows the player with a spring arm.
•	Chase front camera
•	The camera is positioned up-front and is looking backwards. This gives the player the ability to view behind the spaceship. This is a good option if you want to check if a player is chasing you.

o	Everyone should be able to use the controller of their choice. A joystick will provide alternative controls, perfect for another gaming experience of Evolvation. 
•	Maps

•	Spaceships

•	Gamemodes

•	Matchmaking
o	More control in the host screen will let you set up a match which has restrictions for the players that can join.
•	Quickmatch
o	Features such as automatic pooling should be implemented in the quickmatch, to let players land in games which are both challenging and enjoyable. 
•	Fairness indicator
o	Games in the serverlist should have an indication how experienced the players are to enable you to decide which game you want to join.
•	Steam achievements

•	Dedicated servers
•	HUD improvements

•	Match summary screen

•	Voting system next map
o	Players should have the freedom to skip a map.
•	Linux build
o	Extended support of more platforms will allow more people to play Evolvation.
•	Mouse control improvements
o	Currently Evolvation supports but is not optimized for mouse control. Improvements will make the mouse feel like a familiar and conventional addition to the game controls.
•	Steam controller support
o	The steam controller is not yet supported but we aim to provide this option. 
•	Customizable spaceships e.g. colour selection, decal placement.
o	Features such as customizable colours of your ship will make it distinguishable and to your liking.
•	Extra weapons
o	A range of weapons will allow you to pick a weapon that suits your playing style.
•	Level bounds improvement
o	The level bounds should be both distinguishable and unobtrusive
•	Stability improvements
o	Incremental stability improvements
•	Achievements overview improvement
o	The overview should be clear and structured
•	Map orientation indicator for when out of level bounds
o	It should be clear how to return to the map when out of level bounds
•	Class abilities improvement
o	It may be difficult to understand and use the class abilities to their maximum.
•	Stat balance improvement such as damage, health, bonuses from upgrades etc.
•	Tutorial
o	A clear tutorial is needed to introduce players to the game. Guiding players through the process of buying and configuring their first spaceship to let them started to get the most out of Evolvation.
•	Resolution improvements, some items are not aligned properly in the UI.
o	Improve the structure of the complete GUI and HUD
•	AI bot
o	An AI bot enables to train or playing single player.
•	Small single player mode
•	Private team message
o	Implement a private chat to discuss everything you don’t want to share with your enemy. 
•	Magnetic pick-ups’
o	Make it easier to gain a pickup
•	Ability to select default configuration
o	In the lobby or when joining in game the default configuration should be selected to provide a faster start of the game.
•	Lobby redesign
o	Improve the lobby design to be more intuitive and provide more settings such as switching teams.
•	Server list redesign
o	Improve the server list to include filters and make the list sortable
•	Host screen redesign
•	Improve menu background (Flying spaceships)
o	The background should be more interesting and have a more personalised feeling
•	In game stats menu improvements
o	You should be able to quickly look up your statistics in a clear and concise overview
•	Particle effect optimization, better explosions!
o	We are constantly pushing to improve graphics such as explosions.

We will keep you up-to-date with our news flashes on our webpage, via our social media (Google+, Facebook, Twitter, linked in and if we release a video YouTube) and/or via our forum of Evolvation.

Feel free to join the discussion!

Kind regards,

The HyperReuts Team

This currency can be acquired with several in game methods.

•	Kill points: For each enemy kill you receive XP 
•	Assist points: : If you inflicted a certain amount of damage and someone else finishes. You will receive assist points. 
•	Game points: For game related activities such as: capturing a flag, defending a control point, destroying an enemy base etc. 
•	Completing achievements: Evolvation contains a lot of achievements which rewards the player for achieving them. 
•	Winning a game: For winning a game, a player gains experience 
•	Finishing a game: Players get a small reward for finishing a game

In the late future, the currency that we now take as granted, is no more. The evolving need of data in the future has become so important that is has become a currency. Gain data in Evolvation and buy and upgrade your spaceship with your collected data!

After taking the enemy out, a pick-up is dropped at the location of the enemy player which contains a certain amount of data. You are able to pick up this data. The data is in bytes. The data is divided into three categories: Terabytes, petabytes and exabytes. If you have collected 1000 terabytes, you will have 1 petabyte. If you have collected 1000 petabytes, you have one exabyte.

3.	The indicator moves to the target 
4.	When the locking indicator reaches the target, the target is locked 
5.	The warning indicator of the target shows: ”locked” 
6.	You are now able to fire a projectile as a “homing missile” 
7.	The homing missile will follow the target. 
8.	The target will receive a warning indicator: “Missile inbound” 
9.	Unless the target evades the missile properly, the homing missile will be a direct hit!

When you are eliminated by the enemy, the camera goes to an overview mode of the location where you got eliminated and then points to the player which has eliminated you. The camera will follow this player until you got respawned.

[h1]Chat and voice system[/h1]
You are able to chat in game with other player. The colour of the chat messages are defined by the player or team. You are also able to voice chat!



[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
•	Quite some! But these fixes are from closed testing only

[h1]Known bugs[/h1]
•	Loading screen sometimes display the wrong map name
•	It is hard to understand the first steps of the game without a tutorial
•	Crosshair is not the specific aim point for forward thrust.
•	Mouse controls do not work as required
•	At respawn, the game freezes sometimes on particular systems
•	Start-up can take a couple of minutes with black screen. Mostly the first few times.
•	In the hangar, some weapons go through the ground.
•	Kill achievements do not work properly
•	Focus issues improvement e.g. start-up pop up
•	If a second screen is connected, resolution bugs can occur. This can result in no control of your spaceship. Workaround: Change resolution in game and apply settings.
•	In the server list, the friends, history and favourite tabs are not working
•	In the server list the filter buttons do not work
•	If all sounds are disables, the engine sound is still present.
•	Switching teams in lobby is unclear and can result into bugs such as the same player present in both teams
•	If chatting in the lobby, focus issues might appear.
•	All servers in the server list have a ping of 9999
•	The HUD displays Shield down and heat damage, they do not work and are not applicable 
•	You are able to join a game without a configuration
•	The engine of the stealth ships are still in stealth mode after the stealth is finished.
•	Class abilities stats are not present
•	If an achievement is reached and the game is over, the achievement is shown behind the end-game screen.
•	Collision problems, such being able to flying through certain objects.
•	Sometimes after being eliminated, the locking indicator is still active
•	Class ability of the Highspeed does not increase the max speed
•	Killing streaks are calculated throughout levels

[h1]What’s next[/h1]
•	Clan support such as clan names
o	You should be able to distinguish yourself as a member of a clan. Join games together, and enter tournaments. Add new members to your clan in a convenient clan hangar, and hang out together. It is more fun to play with friends!
•	Joystick support
o	Everyone should be able to use the controller of their choice. A joystick will provide alternative controls, perfect for another gaming experience of Evolvation. 
•	Maps
o	More maps allow everyone to show out their skills and will challenge the player to adopt to the diverse environments.
•	Spaceships
o	We aim to develop more ship to let everyone pick one of their choice. It is undefined to which class the ships will belong.
•	Gamemodes
o	More gamemodes need to be created particularly to enhance multiplayer gameplay. The gamemodes should let all the maps and space ship abilities come together to make a challenging game.
•	Matchmaking
o	More control in the host screen will let you set up a match which has restrictions for the players that can join.
•	Quickmatch
o	Features such as automatic pooling should be implemented in the quickmatch, to let players land in games which are both challenging and enjoyable. 
•	Fairness indicator
o	Games in the serverlist should have an indication how experienced the players are to enable you to decide which game you want to join.
•	Steam achievements
o	Steam achievement incorporation will allow you and other players to keep track of your achievements.  
•	Dedicated servers
•	HUD improvements
o	There are some obsolete items such as the heat damage. 
•	Match summary screen
o	The summary screen should be a clear and informative overview
•	Control presets
o	We want to enable players to quickly switch between keyboard (and other controllers) pre-sets to find the setup that matches their needs. These can still be further tweaked in the customize control screen.
•	Kick player from game
o	Inactive players or those who are ruining the gameplay of Evolvation can be voted for to get kicked out of the match. Use and abuse of this function will be tracked to ensure the best gameplay possible.
•	Voting system next map
o	Players should have the freedom to skip a map.
•	Linux build
o	Extended support of more platforms will allow more people to play Evolvation.
•	Mouse control improvements
o	Currently Evolvation supports but is not optimized for mouse control. Improvements will make the mouse feel like a familiar and conventional addition to the game controls.
•	Steam controller support
o	The steam controller is not yet supported but we aim to provide this option. 
•	Customizable spaceships e.g. colour selection, decal placement.
o	Features such as customizable colours of your ship will make it distinguishable and to your liking.
•	Extra weapons
o	A range of weapons will allow you to pick a weapon that suits your playing style.
•	Level bounds improvement
o	The level bounds should be both distinguishable and unobtrusive
•	Stability improvements
o	Incremental stability improvements
•	Achievements overview improvement
o	The overview should be clear and structured
•	Map orientation indicator for when out of level bounds
o	It should be clear how to return to the map when out of level bounds
•	Class abilities improvement
o	It may be difficult to understand and use the class abilities to their maximum.
•	Stat balance improvement such as damage, health, bonuses from upgrades etc.
•	Tutorial
o	A clear tutorial is needed to introduce players to the game. Guiding players through the process of buying and configuring their first spaceship to let them started to get the most out of Evolvation.
•	Resolution improvements, some items are not aligned properly in the UI.
o	Improve the structure of the complete GUI and HUD
•	AI bot
o	An AI bot enables to train or playing single player.
•	Small single player mode
•	Private team message
o	Implement a private chat to discuss everything you don’t want to share with your enemy. 
•	Magnetic pick-ups’
o	Make it easier to gain a pickup
•	Ability to select default configuration
o	In the lobby or when joining in game the default configuration should be selected to provide a faster start of the game.
•	Lobby redesign
o	Improve the lobby design to be more intuitive and provide more settings such as switching teams.
•	Server list redesign
o	Improve the server list to include filters and make the list sortable
•	Host screen redesign
•	Improve menu background (Flying spaceships)
o	The background should be more interesting and have a more personalised feeling
•	In game stats menu improvements
o	You should be able to quickly look up your statistics in a clear and concise overview
•	Particle effect optimization, better explosions!
o	We are constantly pushing to improve graphics such as explosions.

We will keep you up-to-date with our news flashes on our webpage, via our social media (Google+, Facebook, Twitter, linked in and if we release a video YouTube) and/or via our forum of Evolvation.

Feel free to join the discussion!

Kind regards,

The HyperReuts Team
